info.name: Witness API
info.description: Witness: intent verification and payment control for AI shopping agents, on the PayPal sandbox. Set baseUrl and the four role keys (from `pnpm db:seed`). Scenario folders create real sandbox orders. Requests run in order; later requests use ids saved by earlier ones.

item.name: Scenario cart_swap reached VOIDED or VOIDING
Fetch from PayPal: clean purchase captured exactly once
Fetch from PayPal: rejected purchase never reached PayPal
Fetch from PayPal: cart swap voided, nothing captured
Evidence record for the clean purchase
Public: verify one purchase's audit chain
Public: verify the whole audit chain
Shopper: intents and the HOLD decision
Agent can't read an unconfirmed intent
One-time HOLD link for the held scenario
Open the hold with the token (no API key)
Create and confirm an intent for the agent
Replay with the same key returns the same purchase
Same key, different body is refused
Stats: zero captures without an approval
Try to beat it: excluded colour is rejected without a model call
